## Process lifecycle

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
- Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
- Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
- Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
- Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
- Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

## Mobile browser games

- Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
- Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
- Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.
- Follow explicit device and control requirements in the user request.

---
name: gauntlet-loop
description: Turns any goal into one short, paste-ready "gauntlet loop" prompt - a prompt that makes an agent set a concrete quality bar, split the work into small judgeable pieces, run a builder and a separate harsh critic on each, compare blind against the bar, and loop until it wins. Works for builds, writing, code, research, or design. Triggers on "/gauntlet-loop", "gauntlet loop", "gauntlet this", "make a gauntlet prompt", "loop until it beats X".
---

# Gauntlet Loop

The user gives a goal. You give back ONE short prompt they can paste into a fresh agent session.

You are not doing the work. You are writing the prompt that makes another agent grind on the work until it beats a real reference.

## Flow

1. **Read the goal.** One line restatement in your head, not on screen.
2. **Set the bar.** If the user supplied a reference, use it. If not, offer **2 or 3 candidate bars**, one line each, and stop. Wait for their pick. Do not write the prompt yet.
3. **Write the prompt.** One block, paste-ready, no preamble, no headings inside it, no narration after it.
4. **Offer to run it.** One flat line under the prompt: "I can run this here." Not a question.

If they say run it, you become the lead agent and follow the prompt you just wrote.

## The bar is the whole trick

Everything else in a gauntlet loop is scaffolding. The loop only produces quality if the thing it compares against is real.

A bar has to pass three tests:

- **Named.** A specific thing, not a category. "Stripe's pricing page" works. "Award-winning SaaS sites" does not.
- **Fetchable.** The critic can actually get it - screenshot the live page, read the published piece, run the binary, open the repo, watch the footage. If the agent cannot obtain it, it will hallucinate the comparison.
- **Comparable.** Both can sit side by side and a judge can pick one. If you cannot imagine the A/B, it is not a bar.

Bars by goal type:

| Goal | Bar that works |
|---|---|
| Website, app, UI | The live site of a specific best-in-class product, screenshotted at the same viewport |
| Game, 3D, visual | Real footage or screenshots from a named shipped title |
| Writing | A specific published piece by a named author or publication, same length and format |
| Code, tooling | A named repo's implementation, plus its benchmark or test suite as the measurable half |
| Research, analysis | A named analyst report or a paper's methods section, judged on rigour and coverage |
| Deck, doc, deliverable | A real artifact from a firm known for it, same page count |

# 图片搜索 Skill

你是一个专业的图片素材搜索助手，负责为内容创作查找合适的配图。

## 核心能力

1. **多维度过滤**：按尺寸、颜色、类型（照片/插画/GIF）筛选
2. **版权筛选**：支持按授权类型过滤图片
3. **自动下载**：可将图片下载到本地目录
4. **结构化输出**：返回图片元数据便于后续处理

## 使用方式

### 步骤 1：运行搜索脚本

```bash
python scripts/image_search.py "搜索关键词" --max_results 10 --size Large
```

**参数说明：**

- `query`：搜索关键词（必填）
- `--max_results`：返回的最大图片数（默认 10）

name: opencode-zen-completions
description: Use the OpenCode Zen OpenAI-compatible chat completions API when an implementation task needs an external model completion, including listing available models and selecting free models.
---

# OpenCode Zen completions

Use this skill when an implementation needs to send a prompt to the OpenCode Zen completions API. Keep the API call separate from product code unless the user explicitly asks to integrate it.

## Endpoints

- Models: `https://opencode.ai/zen/v1/models`
- Completions: `https://opencode.ai/zen/v1/chat/completions`

The API is OpenAI-compatible. For the public OpenCode CLI-compatible request, use `Authorization: Bearer public`, `Content-Type: application/json`, and the client headers shown below. Treat model availability as live data: query the models endpoint before selecting a model when the exact model matters.

## Model selection

```sh
curl -sS https://opencode.ai/zen/v1/models \
  | jq -r '.data[].id | select(endswith("-free"))'
```

Prefer a currently listed `*-free` model when the user requests free usage. Known examples include `deepseek-v4-flash-free`, `muse-spark-1.2-contributor-free`, `mimo-v2.5-free`, `hy3-free`, `ling-3.0-flash-fin-free`, `nemotron-3-ultra-free`, `nemotron-3.5-lightning-free`, and `laguna-s-2.1-free`, but this list can change.

## Completion request

```sh
curl -sS https://opencode.ai/zen/v1/chat/completions \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer public' \
  -H 'User-Agent: opencode/1.15.9 ai-sdk/provider-utils/4.0.23 runtime/bun/1.3.14' \
  -H 'X-Opencode-Client: cli' \
  -H 'X-Opencode-Project: global' \
  -d '{"model":"mimo-v2.5-free","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"<implementation prompt>"}],"stream":false}' \
  | jq
```

Use `stream: true` only when incremental output is useful. Check the HTTP status and API error object before consuming the completion. Non-streaming text is commonly at `.choices[0].message.content`; inspect the returned shape if the provider reports an error or a different format.

---
name: load-sketchfab-threejs
description: Find low-resource downloadable Sketchfab models, preserve attribution, inspect and normalize GLB materials, load assets and animation clips with official Three.js GLTFLoader and PlayCanvas Container loaders, and prove geometry, animation, and material fidelity in a real browser. Use for Sketchfab search/download, Three.js or PlayCanvas GLB integration, missing or incorrect textures/materials/animations, legacy glTF extensions, camera-framing defects, or browser-visible A/B verification.
---

# Load Sketchfab models into Three.js and PlayCanvas

Use the bundled downloader, inspector, safe normalizer, and A/B viewer. A downloaded file, HTTP 200, or successful loader callback is not completion. Compare the Sketchfab thumbnail with both real engine renders and preserve the generated attribution sidecar.

The downloader enriches every search result with public animation metadata concurrently. Search output includes each clip name, duration, loop flag, and enabled flag without downloading model geometry, textures, or animation binaries. Use `--no-animations` to skip this enrichment or `--animation-workers 1..24` to tune concurrency. The implementation retries HTTP 429 responses with `Retry-After`/exponential backoff and records per-result metadata errors in JSON output.

Every search also creates a visual contact sheet, `sketchfab-preview-sheet.png` by default, plus a same-name `.json` manifest mapping each tile's visible index to its UID, metadata, and thumbnail URL. Use `--preview-sheet /absolute/path/results.png` to choose the output location or `--no-preview-sheet` only when image generation is not useful. The sheet is generated after size/face filters, so it contains exactly the candidates that can be selected with `--download INDEX`.

Searches target non-downloadable Sketchfab models by default. Use `--downloadable` when the user explicitly wants models that offer a download. For non-downloadable searches, omit `--require-glb` and do not promise that the selected model can be integrated; the preview sheet is still valid for visual discovery and matching.

For any search where exact title/tag wording may be brittle, derive a small set of synonyms from the user's description and pass multiple quoted queries:

```sh
python3 "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/download_model.py" \
  "rocket launcher" "RPG viewmodel" "bazooka first person" "launcher weapon" \
  --count 24 --no-animations \
  --preview-sheet /tmp/launcher-search.png
```

The script searches every supplied query, deduplicates models by UID, and creates one combined sheet. Do not treat query order or text matching as proof of suitability; inspect every tile with vision. This mechanism is intentionally asset-agnostic: derive terms for the current subject instead of relying on a fixed query preset.

Public-viewer extraction uses the browser-native exporter under `vendor/sketchfab_downloader_extension`. The primary command launches a temporary isolated headless Chrome/Chromium instance automatically and exits after writing the corrected GLB:

```sh
python3 "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/extract_public_model.py" \
  "https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/example-UID" \
  --output /absolute/project/public/models/model.glb
```

The extraction browser is an internal implementation detail; no A/B viewer or manual browser step is required. The pipeline decrypts meshes, descrambles protected textures, exports skins and animation clips, and posts the finished ZIP back to localhost. The bridge extracts the single GLB and automatically creates `<model>.glb.attribution.json` beside it using `/i/models/{uid}` metadata. It supports legacy 31-character animation IDs, bind-relative bone curves, and one-joint prop attachments that keep their grip position while preserving authored rotation, such as Wizard's hand-held staff. If the metadata endpoint provides no license, record the license as `CC`. Never require a manually created sidecar before building the A/B viewer.

## Keep the test lightweight

Set the skill path once:

# An example hook script to update a checked-out tree on a git push.

# tries to update the branch that is currently checked out and the
# receive.denyCurrentBranch configuration variable is set to
# updateInstead.
#
# By default, such a push is refused if the working tree and the index
# of the remote repository has any difference from the currently
# checked out commit; when both the working tree and the index match
# the current commit, they are updated to match the newly pushed tip
# of the branch. This hook is to be used to override the default
# behaviour; however the code below reimplements the default behaviour
# as a starting point for convenient modification.
#
# The hook receives the commit with which the tip of the current
# branch is going to be updated:
commit=$1

# It can exit with a non-zero status to refuse the push (when it does
# so, it must not modify the index or the working tree).
die () {
	echo >&2 "$*"
	exit 1
}

# Or it can make any necessary changes to the working tree and to the
# index to bring them to the desired state when the tip of the current
# branch is updated to the new commit, and exit with a zero status.
#
# For example, the hook can simply run git read-tree -u -m HEAD "$1"
# in order to emulate git fetch that is run in the reverse direction
# with git push, as the two-tree form of git read-tree -u -m is
# essentially the same as git switch or git checkout that switches
# branches while keeping the local changes in the working tree that do
# not interfere with the difference between the branches.

#!/bin/sh
#

# Called by "git commit" with no arguments.  The hook should
# exit with non-zero status after issuing an appropriate message if
# it wants to stop the commit.
#
# To enable this hook, rename this file to "pre-commit".

if git rev-parse --verify HEAD >/dev/null 2>&1
then
	against=HEAD
else
	# Initial commit: diff against an empty tree object
	against=$(git hash-object -t tree /dev/null)
fi

# If you want to allow non-ASCII filenames set this variable to true.
allownonascii=$(git config --type=bool hooks.allownonascii)

# Redirect output to stderr.
exec 1>&2

# Cross platform projects tend to avoid non-ASCII filenames; prevent
# them from being added to the repository. We exploit the fact that the
# printable range starts at the space character and ends with tilde.
if [ "$allownonascii" != "true" ] &&
	# Note that the use of brackets around a tr range is ok here, (it's
	# even required, for portability to Solaris 10's /usr/bin/tr), since
	# the square bracket bytes happen to fall in the designated range.
	test $(git diff-index --cached --name-only --diff-filter=A -z $against |
	  LC_ALL=C tr -d '[ -~]\0' | wc -c) != 0
then
	cat <<\EOF

import { resolve, join, extname } from 'node:path'
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'
import { createServer } from 'node:http'
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'
import { child } from './session-lifecycle.mjs'
import { livePreviewScript, watchProject } from './live-preview.mjs'

export function projectType(root) {
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'package.json'))) {
    const p = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'), 'utf8'))
    if (p.dependencies?.next || p.devDependencies?.next) throw new Error('Unsupported framework: customize start.sh and provide static deployment output.')
    if (p.dependencies?.vite || p.devDependencies?.vite) return 'vite'
    throw new Error('Unsupported package project: customize start.sh and deployment output.')
  }
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) return 'html'
  throw new Error('No generated index.html or supported package project.')
}

  const type = projectType(root)
  const projectRoot = resolve(root)
  if (type === 'vite') {
    const stampDir = process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR || join(root, 'node_modules', '.cache')
    mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
    const stamp = join(stampDir, 'default-dependencies')
    const lock = join(root, 'package-lock.json')
    const hash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
    let old = ''
    try { old = readFileSync(stamp, 'utf8') } catch {}
    if (old !== hash || !existsSync(join(root, 'node_modules/vite'))) {
      await child('npm', [existsSync(lock) ? 'ci' : 'install', '--no-audit', '--no-fund'], { cwd: root })
      mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
      const installedHash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
      writeFileSync(stamp, installedHash)

  if (process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR) writeFileSync(join(process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR, 'deployment-output.json'), JSON.stringify({ project: projectRoot, directory: resolve(root) }))
  const mime = { '.html':'text/html', '.js':'application/javascript', '.css':'text/css', '.json':'application/json', '.svg':'image/svg+xml', '.png':'image/png', '.jpg':'image/jpeg', '.webp':'image/webp', '.wasm':'application/wasm', '.glb':'model/gltf-binary' }
  const clients = new Set()
  const stopWatching = watchProject(root, () => { for (const client of clients) client.write('event: change\ndata: changed\n\n') })
  const keepAlive = setInterval(() => { for (const client of clients) client.write(': keepalive\n\n') }, 20000)

# Start the saved project and publish readiness only after both HTTP checks pass.
set -euo pipefail
cd "${PROJECT_DIR:?}"
: "${OPENCODE_WEB_DIR:?}" "${APP_URL:?}"
PORT="${APP_PORT:-3000}"
export PORT
startup_timeout="${STARTUP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS:-600}"
[[ "$startup_timeout" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ ]] || { echo 'STARTUP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS must be a positive integer.' >&2; exit 1; }
/usr/bin/time -p test -f start.sh
/usr/bin/time -p bash -n start.sh
current_commit="${CHECKPOINT_COMMIT:-}"
previous_commit=""
[[ ! -f "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/served-commit" ]] || previous_commit="$(/usr/bin/time -p cat "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/served-commit")"
# Reuse an in-flight build for this checkpoint when a readiness retry returns.
starting=false
if [[ -f "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/starting-commit" ]] && [[ "$(/usr/bin/time -p cat "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/starting-commit")" == "$current_commit" ]] && /usr/bin/time -p tmux has-session -t app-server 2>/dev/null; then
  starting=true
fi
if [[ "${RESTART_APP:-false}" == true ]] || { [[ "$starting" == false ]] && { [[ -n "$current_commit" && "$previous_commit" != "$current_commit" ]] || ! /usr/bin/time -p curl --fail --silent --max-time 3 "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/" >/dev/null; }; }; then
  /usr/bin/time -p rm -f "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/ready-preview-url"
  /usr/bin/time -p tmux kill-session -t app-server 2>/dev/null || true
  /usr/bin/time -p node "${RUNTIME_DIR:?}/scripts/reclaim-preview-port.mjs"
  /usr/bin/time -p /usr/bin/printf '%s' "$current_commit" > "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/starting-commit"
  # Pass paths through tmux's environment; keep the script in the foreground.
  /usr/bin/time -p tmux new-session -d -s app-server -c "$PROJECT_DIR" \
    -e "RUNTIME_DIR=${RUNTIME_DIR:?}" -e "OPENCODE_WEB_DIR=$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR" -e "PORT=$PORT" -e "STARTUP_LOG=$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/app.log" \
    'bash start.sh > "$STARTUP_LOG" 2>&1'
fi
ready=false
for ((attempt=0; attempt<(startup_timeout + 1) / 2; attempt++)); do
  /usr/bin/time -p tmux has-session -t app-server 2>/dev/null || { echo 'Startup process exited. Inspect app.log.' >&2; exit 1; }
  if /usr/bin/time -p curl --fail --silent --max-time 3 "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/" >/dev/null; then
    ready=true
    break
  fi
  /usr/bin/time -p tmux has-session -t app-server 2>/dev/null || { echo 'Startup process exited. Inspect app.log.' >&2; exit 1; }
  /usr/bin/time -p sleep 2
done
[[ "$ready" == true ]] || { echo "Local startup failed after ${startup_timeout}s. Inspect app.log." >&2; exit 75; }
/usr/bin/time -p rm -f "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/starting-commit"
# Local readiness is independent of a temporary public tunnel failure.
/usr/bin/time -p /usr/bin/printf '%s' "$current_commit" > "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/served-commit"
for ((attempt=0; attempt<12; attempt++)); do
  status="$(/usr/bin/time -p curl --silent --show-error --location --max-time 10 --output "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/public-readiness.log" --write-out '%{http_code}' "$APP_URL")" || status=000
  if [[ "$status" == 2* ]]; then

    if [[ -n "${OPENCODE_CONTROL_PORT:-}" ]]; then

    fi
    echo 'Local and public preview are ready.'
    exit 0

# 🤯 OMG — Oh My GitHub. ### 🚀 One Prompt In. A Full Game or App Out. 🚀 [![Status](https://img.shields.io/badge/status-🔥%20works-brightgreen?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/denaidark/OhMyGithub/actions) [![GitHub Issues](https://img.shields.io/github/issues/denaidark/OhMyGithub?style=for-the-badge&logo=github)](https://github.com/denaidark/OhMyGithub/issues) [![GitHub Actions](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub%20Actions-automated-2088FF?style=for-the-badge&logo=githubactions&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/denaidark/OhMyGithub/actions) [![OpenCode](https://img.shields.io/badge/powered%20by-OpenCode-111111?style=for-the-badge)](https://opencode.ai/) ```text ╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗ ║ DESCRIBE IT → BUILD IT → TEST IT → PLAY IT ║ ║ ║ ║ One GitHub issue. One prompt. A complete project. ║ ╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝ ``` **No API keys to configure. No server to maintain. No local setup maze.**
--- ## 🤯 What Is OMG? > **Your GitHub issue becomes the product brief.** OMG (Oh My GitHub) is an automated GitHub Actions workflow for creating complete browser games and app projects from one natural-language prompt. Write what you want in an issue and add the `OpenCode` label. OpenCode checks out the project, uses the shared skills, builds the experience, runs tests, verifies the result, and publishes an immutable OmGithub project link from the finished commit. Yes, it creates the code. Yes, it runs the verification loop. Yes, it can expose the result in a temporary browser URL. ## 🧠 TL;DR 1. Open a GitHub issue. 2. Describe the game or app you want. 3. Add the `OpenCode` label to the issue. 4. Let GitHub Actions build, test, verify, and propose the result. ```text Your idea → GitHub issue → OpenCode → tests → immutable OmGithub project ``` ## ⚡ Quick Start Create an issue in your repository with a concrete request: ```text Build a neon asteroid game. Requirements: - Arrow-key movement - Score and restart button - Win and lose states - Responsive browser layout - Run tests and verify it in a browser ``` That is the whole user-facing workflow. GitHub Actions handles the runner, OpenCode handles implementation, and the workflow handles verification plus the immutable project commit. To run against an existing non-default branch, end the issue title with a `branch: ` directive. The directive selects the checkout and is removed before the issue body is sent to OpenCode: ```sh gh issue create \ --repo denaidark/OhMyGithub \ --title "Custom branch smoke test branch: codex/omgithub-site" \ --body "Build a tiny browser page." \ --label Goal \ --label OpenCode ``` The GitHub App validates the branch before dispatching. If the directive is absent, the repository default branch remains the target. ## 🌍 What Can You Build? | 🎯 Use case | ✨ Example | |---|---| | 🎮 Arcade games | Breakout, Space Invaders, Asteroids, Match-3 | | 🧩 Puzzle games | Word games, logic puzzles, card games | | 🏃 Interactive demos | Physics experiments, simulations, visual toys | | 📊 Dashboards | Filters, charts, status panels, analytics views | | 🛠️ Internal tools | Trackers, generators, small workflow apps | | 🌐 Landing pages | Product pages, portfolios, interactive showcases | | 🧪 Prototypes | Turn a product idea into a runnable proof of concept | | 📱 Browser apps | Responsive tools that work on desktop and mobile | ## 🧰 What Happens Automatically? > **The workflow is the product.** - 📥 Checks out your repository and the shared OpenCode skills. - 🏷️ Synchronizes `model/*` and `skill/*` labels. - 🧭 Reads issue labels to select the model and requested skills. - 🤖 Runs OpenCode against the current project. - 🧪 Runs a second verification prompt after implementation. - 🌐 Starts the app and checks the local runtime. - 🔗 Creates a temporary public preview URL when verification passes. - 🔀 Creates and pushes an `opencode/` branch. - 🕹️ Adds an `Open Project` link backed by the repository path, with full-commit links retained for compatibility. - 💬 Posts progress and access details back to the issue. - 🧹 Cleans up temporary tunnels and runner processes. ## 🏷️ Model and Skill Labels Labels let you control the workflow without editing YAML. ```text model/opencode/deepseek-v4.1-flash-free skill/load-sketchfab-threejs skill/gauntlet-loop ``` The workflow validates the selected labels, passes them into OpenCode, and records the resolved model and skills in the run logs. Shared skills are discovered from: ```text .agents/skills//SKILL.md ``` ## 🔄 OpenCode Workflow ```mermaid flowchart TD A[Trigger] --> B[Prepare project] B --> C[Run build.md] C --> D[Run verify.md] D --> E{Public app works?} E -- No --> F[Run public-app-fix.md] F --> E E -- Yes --> G[Run completion-report.md] G --> H{Screenshots exist?} H -- No --> I[Run screenshot-evidence.md] I --> H H -- Yes --> J[Commit and push] J --> K[Create immutable project link] K --> L[Publish report] L --> M[Complete] ``` ## 🏗️ Architecture ```text ┌──────────────┐ ┌─────────────────┐ ┌──────────────┐ │ GitHub issue │ ──▶ │ GitHub Actions │ ──▶ │ OpenCode │ │ + issue text │ │ runner + labels │ │ + .agents │ └──────────────┘ └─────────────────┘ └──────┬───────┘ │ ┌─────────────────────┼─────────────────────┐ ▼ ▼ ▼ Build code Run tests Verify app │ │ │ └─────────────────────┼─────────────────────┘ ▼ ┌────────────────────────┐ │ Commit store + preview │ └────────────────────────┘ ``` ## 🔐 Security and Access - 🔑 You do not need to create or store a project-specific AI API key. - 🖥️ You do not need to operate a dedicated build server. - ☁️ Execution happens in GitHub Actions. - 🔒 Temporary SSH and preview access exists only for the workflow run. - 👀 Review the generated commit before integrating it. - 🛡️ Restrict who can apply the `OpenCode` label in repositories that accept public issues. > “No servers needed” means no servers for you to provision or maintain. The workflow still uses GitHub-hosted Actions infrastructure and temporary workflow services. ## 📁 Project Structure

import * as THREE from 'three'

const clamp = (v, a, b) => Math.max(a, Math.min(b, v))
const damp = (a, b, rate, dt) => a + (b - a) * (1 - Math.exp(-rate * dt))
const lerp = THREE.MathUtils.lerp

function radialTexture() {
  const c = document.createElement('canvas')
  c.width = c.height = 128
  const ctx = c.getContext('2d')
  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(64, 64, 4, 64, 64, 62)
  g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,.8)')
  g.addColorStop(.45, 'rgba(0,0,0,.42)')
  g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)')
  ctx.fillStyle = g
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 128, 128)
  return new THREE.CanvasTexture(c)
}

let shadowMap = null

function capsule(r, length, material, segments = 12) {
  const m = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(r, length, 4, segments), material)
  m.castShadow = true
  m.receiveShadow = true
  return m
}

function box(w, h, d, material, x = 0, y = 0, z = 0) {
  const m = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(w, h, d), material)
  m.position.set(x, y, z)
  m.castShadow = true
  m.receiveShadow = true
  return m
}

function sphere(r, material, sx = 1, sy = 1, sz = 1) {
  const m = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(r, 18, 12), material)
  m.scale.set(sx, sy, sz)
  m.castShadow = true
  m.receiveShadow = true
  return m
}

function cone(r, h, material, seg = 8) {
  const m = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(r, h, seg), material)
  m.castShadow = true
  return m
}

  constructor(config, { x = 0, facing = 1, isPlayer = false } = {}) {

    this.isPlayer = isPlayer
    this.x = x
    this.y = 0
    this.vy = 0

    this.homeX = x
    this.maxHealth = 100
    this.health = 100
    this.energy = 34
    this.maxEnergy = 100
    this.guard = 100
    this.grounded = true
    this.state = 'idle'

    this.stateDuration = 0
    this.attack = null
    this.hitStun = 0
    this.blocking = false
    this.moveDir = 0
    this.invulnerable = false

  _buildMaterials() {
    const c = this.config
    const std = (color, opts = {}) => new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color, roughness: .62, metalness: .08, envMapIntensity: .55, ...opts,
    })
    this.mat = {
      cloth: std(c.cloth, { roughness: .72 }),
      clothDark: std(c.clothDark, { roughness: .78 }),
      skin: std(c.skin, { roughness: .58, metalness: .02 }),
      hair: std(c.hair, { roughness: .85 }),
      trim: std(c.trim, { roughness: .34, metalness: .72, envMapIntensity: 1.1 }),
      metal: std(0x252936, { roughness: .32, metalness: .82, envMapIntensity: 1.15 }),
      sash: std(c.sash, { roughness: .8 }),
      glow: std(c.glow, { color: c.glow, emissive: c.glow, emissiveIntensity: 3.2, roughness: .3, toneMapped: false }),
      glowSoft: std(c.glow, { color: c.glow, emissive: c.glow, emissiveIntensity: 1.25, roughness: .45, transparent: true, opacity: .5, toneMapped: false }),
      dark: std(0x0c0e15, { roughness: .6 }),

  _buildModel() {
    const M = this.mat
    // Body pivot — animations lean from the hips.

    const belt = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(.31, .045, 6, 20), M.trim)
    belt.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2
    belt.scale.z = .86
    belt.position.y = .12
    belt.castShadow = true
    this.body.add(belt)
    this.waistTail = new THREE.Group()
    this.waistTail.position.set(-.18, .1, -.12)
    this.body.add(this.waistTail)
    const tailA = box(.035, .52, .26, M.cloth, 0, -.26, 0)
    const tailB = box(.03, .38, .18, M.cloth, -.04, -.2, .2)
    this.waistTail.add(tailA, tailB)

    // Chest group for torso twist.
    this.chest = new THREE.Group()
    this.chest.position.y = .18

    const torsoGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.36, .29, .7, 7)
    const torso = new THREE.Mesh(torsoGeo, M.cloth)
    torso.scale.z = .72
    torso.position.y = .35

    this.chest.add(torso)
    const chestPlate = box(.14, .42, .32, M.clothDark, .22, .42, 0)

    this.chest.add(chestPlate)

    yoke.position.y = .66
    yoke.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2
    yoke.rotation.z = Math.PI
    yoke.scale.z = .8
    this.chest.add(yoke)

    // Head.
    this.head = new THREE.Group()
    this.head.position.y = .93
    this.chest.add(this.head)
    const skull = sphere(.205, M.skin, 1, 1.08, .94)
    skull.position.y = .06
    this.head.add(skull)
    const jaw = sphere(.155, M.skin, 1.1, .82, .88)

      this.head.add(eye)
    }
    const brow = box(.035, .018, .3, M.trim, .185, .115, 0)
    brow.rotation.z = -.13
    this.head.add(brow)
    // Hair.
    const hair = sphere(.218, M.hair, 1.02, 1.05, 1)
    hair.position.set(-.02, .12, 0)
    hair.scale.y = .9
    this.head.add(hair)
    if (this.config.id === 'kaze') {
      const band = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(.21, .028, 5, 18), M.trim)
      band.rotation.y = Math.PI / 2
      band.position.y = .13
      band.scale.z = .97
      this.head.add(band)
      this.bandTail = new THREE.Group()
      this.bandTail.position.set(-.17, .12, .05)
      this.head.add(this.bandTail)
      this.bandTail.add(box(.42, .045, .012, M.trim, -.21, -.03, 0), box(.3, .035, .01, M.trim, -.16, -.11, .04))
      // Spiky hair.
      for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        const spike = cone(.07, .26 + (i % 2) * .08, M.hair, 5)
        spike.position.set(-.12 + i * .035, .2 + (i % 2) * .05, -.13 + i * .065)

      const upper = capsule(.085, .27, M.cloth)

      const bicepBand = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(.09, .02, 5, 12), M.trim)
      bicepBand.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2
      bicepBand.position.y = -.32
      shoulder.add(bicepBand)
      const elbow = new THREE.Group()
      elbow.position.y = -.4

      fore.position.y = -.19
      elbow.add(fore)
      const wrap = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.079, .068, .18, 8), M.sash)
      wrap.position.y = -.29
      elbow.add(wrap)
      const stripe = box(.012, .2, .075, M.glow, .0, -.29, side * .052)

      hand.position.y = -.39
      elbow.add(hand)

    // Legs.

    for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
      const hip = new THREE.Group()
      hip.position.set(0, -.01, side * .17)
      this.rig.add(hip)
      const thigh = capsule(.105, .29, M.clothDark)
      thigh.position.y = -.2
      hip.add(thigh)
      const thighArmor = box(.16, .3, .16, M.cloth, .04, -.2, 0)

  _buildShadow() {

      new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: shadowMap, transparent: true, opacity: .56, depthWrite: false })
    )
    this.shadow.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2
    this.shadow.position.y = .015
    this.shadow.renderOrder = 1
    this.root.add(this.shadow)
  }

  _blankPose() {
    return {
      bodyY: 1.02, bodyLean: 0, bodyRoll: 0, bodyYaw: 0, bodyScale: 1,
      chestYaw: 0, chestPitch: 0, headYaw: 0, headPitch: 0,
      armL: [0, 0, -.2], armR: [0, 0, -.2],
      foreL: [0, 0, 0], foreR: [0, 0, 0],
      legL: [0, 0, 0], legR: [0, 0, 0],
      kneeL: [0, 0, 0], kneeR: [0, 0, 0],
      ankleL: [0, 0, 0], ankleR: [0, 0, 0],
      rootYaw: 0, rootTilt: 0, rootY: 0,
    }
  }

  setPose(target) {
    this.target = target
  }

  updateAnimation(dt, t) {
    const p = this._blankPose()
    const s = this.state
    const st = this.stateTime
    const walking = this.moveDir !== 0 && this.grounded && ['idle', 'walk'].includes(s)
    const guard = this.blocking && this.grounded
    const breathe = Math.sin(t * 2.2 + (this.isPlayer ? 0 : 1.7))

    // Base idle.
    p.bodyY = 1.02 + breathe * .012
    p.bodyLean = -.055 + breathe * .012
    p.bodyYaw = 0
    p.headYaw = Math.sin(t * .7) * .05
    p.armL = [.16, 0, .72]
    p.armR = [-.1, 0, .58]
    p.foreL = [0, 0, 1.92]
    p.foreR = [0, 0, 1.82]
    p.legL = [0, 0, -.39]
    p.legR = [0, 0, .47]
    p.kneeL = [0, 0, .52]
    p.kneeR = [0, 0, .38]
    p.ankleL = [0, 0, -.12]
    p.ankleR = [0, 0, -.06]

    if (walking) {
      this.walkPhase += dt * 9.5
      const w = Math.sin(this.walkPhase)
      p.bodyY += Math.abs(w) * .028
      p.bodyLean = -.14
      p.legL[2] = -.4 + w * .46
      p.legR[2] = .47 - w * .46
      p.kneeL[2] = .55 + Math.max(0, -w) * .45
      p.kneeR[2] = .38 + Math.max(0, w) * .45
      p.armL[2] = .72 - w * .14
      p.armR[2] = .58 + w * .12
      p.chestYaw = -.08 + w * .05
    }

    if (!this.grounded) {
      p.bodyY = 1.02
      p.bodyLean = -.18
      p.legL[2] = .95
      p.legR[2] = -.5
      p.kneeL[2] = 1.3
      p.kneeR[2] = .5
      p.armL[2] = 1.05
      p.armR[2] = 1.15
      p.foreL[2] = 1.4
      p.foreR[2] = 1.5
      p.bodyRoll = -.1
      if (this.vy > 1) p.bodyLean = -.05
    }

    if (guard) {
      p.bodyY = .9
      p.bodyLean = -.1
      p.armL = [.35, 0, 1.17]
      p.armR = [-.3, 0, 1.28]
      p.foreL = [0, 0, 2.17]
      p.foreR = [0, 0, 2.05]
      p.legL[2] = -.48
      p.legR[2] = .55
      p.kneeL[2] = .7
      p.kneeR[2] = .55
      p.headPitch = .08
      p.bodyRoll = .06
    }

    if (this.hitStun > 0 && !['ko', 'attack'].includes(s)) {
      const k = Math.min(1, this.hitStun * 5)
      p.bodyLean = .2 * k
      p.bodyRoll = .12 * k
      p.headPitch = -.28 * k
      p.armL = [.4, 0, .2]
      p.armR = [-.35, 0, .1]
      p.foreL = [0, 0, .7]
      p.foreR = [0, 0, .5]
    }

    if (s === 'attack' && this.attack) {
      const a = this.attack
      const total = a.startup + a.active + a.recovery
      const phase = st / total
      const activeStart = a.startup / total
      const activeEnd = (a.startup + a.active) / total
      const punchArm = a.kind === 'punch' ? 1 : -1
      const front = this.arms[1]
      const back = this.arms[0]
      if (a.kind === 'punch') {
        const wind = st < a.startup ? st / a.startup : 1
        const strike = st >= a.startup && st < a.startup + a.active
          ? 1 : st >= a.startup + a.active ? Math.max(0, 1 - (st - a.startup - a.active) / a.recovery) : 0
        const reach = strike > 0 ? 1.52 + strike * .15 : .55 + wind * .4
        p.armR = [-.08, 0, reach]
        p.foreR = [0, 0, strike > 0 ? .05 : 2.3]
        p.armL = [.28, 0, .95]
        p.foreL = [0, 0, 2.2]
        p.chestYaw = -.28 * strike + .08 * wind
        p.bodyLean = -.08 - strike * .1
        p.bodyY = 1.0 - strike * .02
        p.legL[2] = -.6
        p.legR[2] = .7
        p.kneeL[2] = .55
        p.kneeR[2] = .35
      } else if (a.kind === 'kick') {
        const strike = st >= a.startup && st < a.startup + a.active ? 1
          : st >= a.startup + a.active ? Math.max(0, 1 - (st - a.startup - a.active) / a.recovery) : 0
        const wind = Math.min(1, st / a.startup)
        p.legR[2] = .5 + (strike > 0 ? 1.05 : wind * .45)
        p.kneeR[2] = strike > 0 ? .12 : 1.1
        p.ankleR[2] = strike > 0 ? .1 : -.2
        p.legL[2] = -.35
        p.kneeL[2] = .45 + strike * .15
        p.bodyLean = .16 - strike * .05
        p.bodyRoll = -.08
        p.bodyY = 1.03
        p.armL = [.32, 0, 1.1]
        p.armR = [-.4, 0, .35]
        p.foreL = [0, 0, 1.9]
        p.foreR = [0, 0, 1.2]
        p.chestYaw = .14
      } else if (a.kind === 'palm') {
        const ready = Math.min(1, st / Math.max(.12, a.startup))
        const push = st >= a.startup ? 1 : 0
        const settle = Math.max(0, 1 - st / total)
        p.bodyY = .97 - ready * .06 + push * .04
        p.bodyLean = -.23 - push * .2
        p.armL = [.22, 0, .14 + ready * 1.42]
        p.armR = [-.22, 0, .14 + ready * 1.42]
        p.foreL = [0, 0, .3 + ready * .25]
        p.foreR = [0, 0, .3 + ready * .25]
        p.legL[2] = -.58
        p.legR[2] = .66
        p.kneeL[2] = .75
        p.kneeR[2] = .4
        p.chestYaw = 0
        p.headPitch = -.03
        this.aura = Math.max(this.aura, ready * .55)
        if (push) this.aura = Math.max(this.aura, settle * .7)
      } else if (a.kind === 'rush') {
        const run = st < a.startup + a.active ? 1 : 0
        p.bodyY = .9
        p.bodyLean = -.45
        p.bodyRoll = -.05
        p.chestYaw = -.38
        p.armR = [-.1, 0, 1.5]
        p.foreR = [0, 0, .12]
        p.armL = [.4, 0, .1]
        p.foreL = [0, 0, .55]
        p.legL[2] = -.8
        p.legR[2] = 1.0
        p.kneeL[2] = .8
        p.kneeR[2] = .4
        p.ankleR[2] = .3
        this.aura = Math.max(this.aura, run * .65)
      } else if (a.kind === 'storm') {
        const wind = Math.min(1, st / a.startup)
        const rise = st >= a.startup && st < a.startup + a.active ? 1 : 0
        const settle = Math.max(0, 1 - (st - a.startup - a.active) / Math.max(.01, a.recovery))
        p.bodyLean = -.35 - rise * .2
        p.bodyRoll = -.18 * rise
        p.rootYaw = st < a.startup ? Math.sin(st * 22) * .1 * wind : (st - a.startup) * 10
        p.bodyY = 1.02 + rise * .28 * Math.sin(Math.min(1, st / (a.startup + a.active)) * Math.PI)
        p.armR = [-.2, 0, .2 + rise * 1.3]
        p.foreR = [0, 0, .2]
        p.armL = [.4, 0, .25 + rise * .65]
        p.foreL = [0, 0, .9]
        p.legL[2] = -.3
        p.legR[2] = rise ? -0.1 : .6
        p.kneeL[2] = rise ? 1.1 : .6
        p.kneeR[2] = rise ? .7 : .4
        p.ankleL[2] = .2
        this.aura = Math.max(this.aura, .55 + wind * .45)
      }
    }

    if (s === 'ko') {
      const k = clamp(this.koTimer / 1.1, 0, 1)
      const ease = 1 - Math.pow(1 - k, 3)
      p.rootTilt = -1.38 * ease
      p.rootY = -.05 + .0 * ease
      p.bodyY = 1.02 - ease * .15
      p.bodyLean = .2 + ease * .3
      p.bodyRoll = .2
      p.armL = [.4, 0, .15]
      p.armR = [-.5, 0, .05]
      p.foreL = [0, 0, .3]
      p.foreR = [0, 0, .2]
      p.legL[2] = .4
      p.legR[2] = -.2
      p.kneeL[2] = .7
      p.kneeR[2] = .3
      p.headPitch = -.3
      p.headYaw = .3
    }

    if (s === 'victory') {
      const v = Math.sin(t * 5) * .06
      p.bodyY = 1.03 + v
      p.bodyLean = .04
      p.armR = [-.2, 0, 3.03]
      p.foreR = [0, 0, .15]
      p.armL = [.2, 0, 2.7]
      p.foreL = [0, 0, .2]
      p.chestYaw = .12
      p.headPitch = -.15
      p.legL[2] = -.32
      p.legR[2] = .4
    }

    if (this.flash > 0) {
      this.flash = Math.max(0, this.flash - dt * 7)
    }

    this.setPose(p)
  }

  applyPose(dt) {
    const p = this.target, a = this.anim
    const keys = ['bodyY', 'bodyLean', 'bodyRoll', 'bodyYaw', 'bodyScale', 'chestYaw', 'chestPitch', 'headYaw', 'headPitch', 'rootYaw', 'rootTilt', 'rootY']
    for (const k of keys) a[k] = damp(a[k], p[k], 18, dt)
    for (const k of ['armL', 'armR', 'foreL', 'foreR', 'legL', 'legR', 'kneeL', 'kneeR', 'ankleL', 'ankleR']) {
      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) a[k][i] = damp(a[k][i], p[k][i], 22, dt)
    }
    this.body.position.y = a.bodyY
    this.body.rotation.z = a.bodyLean
    this.body.rotation.x = a.bodyRoll
    this.body.rotation.y = a.bodyYaw
    this.chest.rotation.y = a.chestYaw
    this.chest.rotation.x = a.chestPitch
    this.head.rotation.y = a.headYaw
    this.head.rotation.x = a.headPitch
    this.arms[0].shoulder.rotation.set(a.armL[0], a.armL[1], a.armL[2])
    this.arms[1].shoulder.rotation.set(a.armR[0], a.armR[1], a.armR[2])
    this.arms[0].elbow.rotation.set(a.foreL[0], a.foreL[1], a.foreL[2])
    this.arms[1].elbow.rotation.set(a.foreR[0], a.foreR[1], a.foreR[2])
    this.legs[0].hip.rotation.set(a.legL[0], a.legL[1], a.legL[2])
    this.legs[1].hip.rotation.set(a.legR[0], a.legR[1], a.legR[2])
    this.legs[0].knee.rotation.set(a.kneeL[0], a.kneeL[1], a.kneeL[2])
    this.legs[1].knee.rotation.set(a.kneeR[0], a.kneeR[1], a.kneeR[2])
    this.legs[0].ankle.rotation.set(a.ankleL[0], a.ankleL[1], a.ankleL[2])
    this.legs[1].ankle.rotation.set(a.ankleR[0], a.ankleR[1], a.ankleR[2])
    this.rig.rotation.y = a.rootYaw
    this.root.rotation.z = a.rootTilt
    this.root.rotation.y = (this.facing > 0 ? 0 : Math.PI) + a.rootYaw * 0
    this.rig.position.y = a.rootY
    // Aura + flash.
    this.aura = damp(this.aura, 0, 5, dt)
    this.auraMesh.material.opacity = this.aura * .23
    this.auraMesh.scale.set(.78 + this.aura * .3, 1.28 + this.aura * .32, .78 + this.aura * .3)
    if (this.auraMesh.material.opacity < .003) this.auraMesh.visible = false
    else this.auraMesh.visible = true
    const flashOn = this.flash > 0 ? 1 : 0
    for (const m of [this.mat.cloth, this.mat.clothDark, this.mat.skin]) {
      m.emissiveIntensity = flashOn * .8
      m.emissive.setHex(flashOn ? 0xff6b45 : 0x000000)
    }
    // Cloth sway.
    const sway = Math.sin(performance.now() * .006 + this.walkPhase) * .12
    this.scarf.rotation.z = -.2 + sway
    this.scarf.rotation.x = .18 + Math.sin(performance.now() * .004) * .06
    this.waistTail.rotation.z = .12 + sway * .7
    if (this.bandTail) this.bandTail.rotation.z = .18 + Math.sin(performance.now() * .009) * .18
    if (this.hairTail) this.hairTail.rotation.z = .28 + Math.sin(performance.now() * .004) * .08
    // Shadow follows jump height.
    this.shadow.position.y = .016 - this.y
    const sh = clamp(1 - this.y * .22, .45, 1)
    this.shadow.scale.set(sh, sh, 1)
    this.shadow.material.opacity = .5 * sh
    // Root transform.
    this.root.position.x = this.x
    this.root.position.y = this.y
    this.root.rotation.y = this.facing > 0 ? 0 : Math.PI
  }

  setState(state, duration = 0) {
    this.state = state
    this.stateTime = 0
    this.stateDuration = duration
  }

  reset(x, facing, health = 100) {
    this.x = x
    this.homeX = x
    this.y = 0
    this.vy = 0
    this.vx = 0
    this.facing = facing
    this.health = health
    this.energy = Math.max(this.energy, 25)
    this.guard = 100
    this.grounded = true
    this.state = 'idle'
    this.stateTime = 0
    this.attack = null
    this.hitStun = 0
    this.blocking = false
    this.invulnerable = false
    this.flash = 0
    this.aura = 0
    this.koTimer = 0
    this.root.rotation.set(0, facing > 0 ? 0 : Math.PI, 0)
    this.root.position.set(x, 0, 0)
  }

  get forward() {
    return this.facing > 0 ? 1 : -1
  }
}

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D street-fighting game featuring a duel and three special moves.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them on completion.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks (viewport ≤1280px wide) and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Built “NEON FIST — Rooftop Reckoning,” a Three.js fighting game with procedural 3D fighters, a rooftop arena, synthesized audio, keyboard/touch controls, and three chi moves: Palm, Rush, and Storm.
- Used Vite and Three.js; game runs against an AI opponent in best-of-three rounds.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented the game, UI, arena, fighters, effects, and audio in `src/`.
- Added project metadata and dependencies; `npm install` completed.
- `node --check` passed for the JavaScript modules; `npm run build` succeeded (with a >500 kB chunk warning).
- Started Vite dev server on port 3002; `curl` confirmed HTTP 200.

### Active
- Validate the game in a browser and fix any runtime or visual issues.
- Produce and inspect a latest small JPEG screenshot as requested.

### Blocked
- Browser check via `playwright-cli` failed while configuring its browser session. The last error indicated it tried to open `/home/runner/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json,/home/runner/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json`; use the wrapper without manually passing `--config`.

## Next Move
1. Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` from the repository so the wrapper supplies its configuration.
2. Check browser console/runtime behavior, launch a match, and exercise the three special moves.
3. Save and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot; fix issues found and rerun `npm run build`.
4. Summarize the playable controls and assumptions when finished.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game entry document and UI structure.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and Three.js dependency.
- `src/main.js`: Game setup, controls, combat, AI, round flow, and rendering.
- `src/style.css`: Game presentation and responsive layout.
- `src/fighter.js`: Fighter models and animation.
- `src/arena.js`: Rooftop arena, lighting, and weather.
- `src/fx.js`: Combat effects and projectiles.
- `src/ui.js`: HUD, menu, pause, and result screens.
- `src/audio.js`: Procedural sound engine.
- `public/fonts/`: Locally downloaded font assets.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; no commit or push was made.
- Build output warned the minified JavaScript chunk is 661.85 kB.
- Dev server was launched with `npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 3002`.

551:   const isUltimate = Boolean(move.ultimate)
552:   attacker.comboHits = (game.time - attacker.lastHitAt < 1.15) ? attacker.comboHits + 1 : 1

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D street-fighting duel with three special moves.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them on completion.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks (viewport ≤1280px wide) and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Built “NEON FIST — Rooftop Reckoning,” a Three.js game with procedural 3D fighters, rooftop arena, synthesized audio, keyboard/touch controls, and three chi moves: Tempest Palm, Dragon Rush, and Heaven’s Wrath.
- Uses Vite; matches are best-of-three against AI.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented game, UI, arena, fighters, effects, and audio in `src/`.
- Installed dependencies; JavaScript syntax checks and `npm run build` passed.
- Started Vite on port 3002; confirmed HTTP 200.
- Opened the game in Playwright. Menu and match-start flows work; browser reported zero errors.
- Match HUD showed round timer, health/chi, specials, combo, guard, and pause controls.

368: function updateFighter(f, dt, opponent) {
369:   if (f.state === 'ko') {

371:     if (!f.grounded) {
372:       f.vy -= 15 * dt
373:       f.y = Math.max(0, f.y + f.vy * dt)

375:     }
376:   }
377:   f.stateTime += dt
378:   f.hitStun = Math.max(0, f.hitStun - dt)
379: 
380:   // Attack progression.
381:   if (f.state === 'attack' && f.attack) {
382:     const a = f.attack
383:     const t = f.stateTime
384:     const total = a.startup + a.active + a.recovery
385:     if (a.kind === 'rush' && t > a.startup * .65 && t < a.startup + a.active) {
386:       const envelope = Math.sin(Math.min(1, (t - a.startup * .65) / (a.active + a.startup * .35)) * Math.PI)
387:       f.x += f.forward * a.dash * envelope * dt
388:       f.vx = f.forward * a.dash * envelope
389:       if (Math.random() < .35) fx.burst(new THREE.Vector3(f.x - f.forward * .5, 1.0, .1), f.config.glow, { count: 2, speed: 1.5, size: .08, life: .3, gravity: 1 })
390:     }
391:     if (a.kind === 'palm' && !a.fired && t >= a.startup * .82) {
392:       a.fired = true
393:       fx.spawnProjectile(f, 1)
394:       fx.burst(new THREE.Vector3(f.x + f.forward * .8, 1.12, .1), f.config.glow, { count: 22, speed: 4.5, size: .16, life: .5, gravity: 1 })
395:       sound.zap()
396:       game.shake = Math.max(game.shake, .14)
397:     }
398:     if (a.kind === 'storm' && !a.announced && t >= a.startup * .7) {
399:       a.announced = true
400:       ui.announce("HEAVEN'S WRATH", f.isPlayer ? 'THE STORM BREAKS' : 'SHOGUN UNLEASHES THE TEMPEST', 'special')
401:       sound.charge(1.0, 70)
402:       game.shake = Math.max(game.shake, .28)
403:       ui.flash('lightning')
404:       for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
405:         setTimeout(() => {
406:           fx.lightningStrike(opponent.x + (Math.random() - .5) * 1.4, .2 + (Math.random() - .5) * .8, f.config.glow)
407:         }, i * 95)
408:       }
409:     }
410:     if (t >= total) {
411:       f.setState('idle')
412:       f.attack = null
413:       f.vx *= .5
414:     }
415:   } else if (f.state === 'hit' && f.stateTime >= f.stateDuration) {
416:     f.setState(f.grounded ? 'idle' : 'air')
417:   } else if (f.state === 'victory' && f.stateTime > 4) {
418:     // Stay in victory pose.
419:   }
420: 
421:   // Jump physics.
422:   if (!f.grounded && f.state !== 'ko') {
423:     f.vy -= 17.5 * dt
424:     f.y += f.vy * dt
425:     if (f.y <= 0) {
426:       f.y = 0
427:       f.vy = 0
428:       f.grounded = true
429:       if (f.state === 'air') f.setState('idle')
430:       if (f.state !== 'attack' && f.state !== 'hit') f.setState('idle')
431:       fx.dust(f.x, .06, f.isPlayer ? 0x5be6ff : 0xff6a4a)
432:     }
433:   }
434: 
435:   // Movement.
436:   const busy = f.state === 'attack' || f.state === 'hit' || f.state === 'ko' || f.state === 'victory'
437:   f.blocking = false
438:   if (game.mode === 'fight' && !busy) {
439:     let move = 0
440:     let blocking = false
441:     if (f.isPlayer) {
442:       move = playerInput.move
443:       blocking = playerInput.block && f.grounded
444:     } else {
445:       move = ai.intent
446:       blocking = ai.blockTimer > 0 && f.grounded
447:     }
448:     f.moveDir = move
449:     f.blocking = blocking
450:     if (blocking) {
451:       f.state = 'idle'
452:       f.x += move * 1.15 * dt
453:     } else if (move !== 0) {
454:       const towards = Math.sign(opponent.x - f.x) * move > 0
455:       f.x += move * (towards ? 3.55 : 2.85) * dt
456:       f.state = f.grounded ? 'walk' : 'air'
457:     } else {
458:       if (f.grounded) f.state = 'idle'
459:       else f.state = 'air'
460:     }
461:     // Guard regeneration.
462:     if (!blocking) f.guard = Math.min(100, f.guard + 15 * dt)
463:   } else if (f.state !== 'attack' && f.state !== 'hit' && f.state !== 'ko' && f.state !== 'victory' && f.state !== 'air') {
464:     f.moveDir = 0
465:     f.state = 'idle'
466:     f.guard = Math.min(100, f.guard + 8 * dt)
467:   }
468:   if (f.state === 'attack') f.moveDir = 0
469: 
470:   // Energy always builds slowly (except during KO screen where it makes no difference).
471:   if (game.mode === 'fight') {
472:     f.energy = Math.min(f.maxEnergy, f.energy + (f.isPlayer ? 5.2 : 4.6) * dt)
473:   }
474: 
475:   // Facing.
476:   if (!busy && game.mode !== 'menu') {
477:     f.facing = opponent.x >= f.x ? 1 : -1
478:   }
479:   // Keep the duel inside the ring.
480:   f.x = Math.max(-5.9, Math.min(5.9, f.x))
481: }

483: function resolveSpacing() {
484:   const min = .82
485:   const delta = enemy.x - player.x
486:   if (Math.abs(delta) < min) {
487:     const push = (min - Math.abs(delta)) * .5
488:     const s = delta >= 0 ? 1 : -1
489:     player.x -= push * s
490:     enemy.x += push * s
491:   }
492:   if (Math.abs(player.x) > 5.92) player.x = Math.sign(player.x) * 5.92
493:   if (Math.abs(enemy.x) > 5.92) enemy.x = Math.sign(enemy.x) * 5.92
494: }

496: function activePhase(f, a) {
497:   return f.stateTime >= a.startup && f.stateTime <= a.startup + a.active

500: function checkAttackHit(attacker, defender) {
501:   if (attacker.state !== 'attack' || !attacker.attack) return
502:   const a = attacker.attack
503:   if (a.hit || !activePhase(attacker, a)) return
504:   if (a.kind === 'palm') return
505:   const d = rectDistance(attacker, defender)
506:   const range = a.kind === 'rush' ? 1.85 : a.range
507:   const vertical = Math.abs(attacker.y - defender.y)
508:   if (d <= range && vertical < 1.5) {
509:     a.hit = true
510:     applyHit(attacker, defender, a)
511:   }
512: }

514: function applyHit(attacker, defender, move, projectile = false) {
515:   if (defender.state === 'ko' || defender.invulnerable) return
516:   const blocked = defender.blocking && defender.grounded && defender.guard > 0 && !move.ultimate
517:   const hitPos = new THREE.Vector3(
518:     defender.x - defender.forward * .18,
519:     defender.y + 1.25,
520:     .32
521:   )
522:   const color = attacker.config.glow
523:   const damageScale = 1 - Math.min(.34, Math.max(0, attacker.comboHits - 1) * .035)
524:   let damage = move.damage * damageScale
525: 
526:   if (blocked) {
527:     defender.guard = Math.max(0, defender.guard - move.damage * 2.2)
528:     defender.hitStun = Math.max(defender.hitStun, .12)
529:     defender.x += attacker.forward * (move.push || .2) * .38
530:     damage *= .1
531:     defender.health = Math.max(0, defender.health - damage)
532:     attacker.energy = Math.min(100, attacker.energy + (move.gain || 5) * .5)
533:     fx.impact(hitPos, 0x8ceaff, .8, true)
534:     sound.block()
535:     sound.hit(.45, true)
536:     game.shake = Math.max(game.shake, .1)
537:     game.hitstop = Math.max(game.hitstop, .035)
538:     ui.setHealth(defender.isPlayer ? 'player' : 'enemy', defender.health)
539:     ui.damageAt(hitPos, camera, 'BLOCK', false)
540:     if (defender.guard <= 0) {
541:       defender.blocking = false
542:       defender.hitStun = .62
543:       defender.setState('hit', .62)
544:       ui.announce('GUARD BREAK', 'DEFENSE SHATTERED', '')
545:       game.shake = Math.max(game.shake, .3)
546:       sound.hit(1.2)
547:     }
548:     return
549:   }
550: 
551:   const isUltimate = Boolean(move.ultimate)
552:   attacker.comboHits = (game.time - attacker.lastHitAt < 1.15) ? attacker.comboHits + 1 : 1
553:   attacker.lastHitAt = game.time
554:   attacker.health = attacker.health
555:   attacker.energy = Math.min(100, attacker.energy + (move.gain || 5))
556:   defender.energy = Math.min(100, defender.energy + (move.gain || 5) * .55)
557:   defender.health = Math.max(0, defender.health - damage)
558:   defender.flash = .16
559:   defender.hitStun = .22 + damage * .014
560:   defender.setState('hit', defender.hitStun)
561:   defender.x += attacker.forward * (move.push || .24)
562:   if (isUltimate) {
563:     defender.grounded = false
564:     defender.vy = 5.4
565:     defender.y = .08
566:     defender.setState('hit', .7)
567:     game.slowmo = Math.max(game.slowmo, .55)
568:   }
569:   game.hitstop = Math.max(game.hitstop, isUltimate ? .11 : .055)
570:   game.shake = Math.max(game.shake, isUltimate ? .55 : .16 + damage * .007)
571:   sound.hit(isUltimate ? 1.7 : .8 + damage * .04)
572:   fx.impact(hitPos, isUltimate ? 0xffe0a0 : color, isUltimate ? 1.8 : 1, false)
573:   fx.slash(hitPos, isUltimate ? 0xffe0a0 : color, Math.random() * Math.PI)
574:   if (isUltimate) {
575:     fx.groundWave(defender.x, .15, 0xffc86b, 1.4)
576:     ui.flash('lightning')
577:     arena.strikeLightning(1)
578:   } else {
579:     ui.flash('impact')
580:   }
581:   ui.setHealth(defender.isPlayer ? 'player' : 'enemy', defender.health)
582:   ui.damageAt(hitPos, camera, Math.round(damage), isUltimate || attacker.comboHits >= 4)
583:   if (attacker.comboHits >= 2) ui.combo(attacker.comboHits)
584:   if (attacker.isPlayer) {
585:     game.combo = attacker.comboHits
586:     game.maxCombo = Math.max(game.maxCombo, attacker.comboHits)
587:   }
588:   game.lastHitter = attacker
589:   if (attacker.isPlayer) ui.setEnergy('player', attacker.energy)
590:   else ui.setEnergy('enemy', attacker.energy)
591:   if (defender.health <= 0) endRound(attacker, 'ko')
592: }

594: function handleProjectiles(dt) {
595:   for (let i = fx.projectiles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
596:     const p = fx.projectiles[i]
597:     if (p.hit) continue
598:     const target = p.owner === player ? enemy : player
599:     const pos = p.group.position
600:     const d = Math.abs(pos.x - target.x)
601:     if (d < .58 + p.radius && Math.abs(pos.y - (target.y + 1.1)) < 1.25 && target.state !== 'ko') {
602:       p.hit = true
603:       applyHit(p.owner, target, MOVES.palm, true)
604:       fx.despawnProjectile(p)
605:       fx.projectiles.splice(i, 1)
606:       continue
607:     }
608:     // Projectiles clash in the middle.
609:     const other = fx.projectiles.find(o => o !== p && o.owner !== p.owner && !o.hit && Math.abs(o.group.position.x - pos.x) < .55)
610:     if (other) {
611:       p.hit = true
612:       other.hit = true
613:       const mid = p.group.position.clone().add(other.group.position).multiplyScalar(.5)
614:       fx.impact(mid, 0xffffff, 1.7)
615:       sound.zap()
616:       game.shake = Math.max(game.shake, .25)
617:       fx.despawnProjectile(p)
618:       fx.despawnProjectile(other)
619:     }
620:   }
621: }

623: function updateAI(dt) {
624:   if (game.mode !== 'fight') return
625:   if (enemy.state === 'ko' || enemy.state === 'victory' || enemy.state === 'attack' || enemy.state === 'hit') {
626:     if (enemy.state !== 'attack') ai.intent = 0
627:     return
628:   }
629:   ai.think -= dt
630:   ai.cooldown = Math.max(0, ai.cooldown - dt)
631:   ai.specialTimer = Math.max(0, ai.specialTimer - dt)
632:   ai.blockTimer = Math.max(0, ai.blockTimer - dt)
633:   const dist = Math.abs(player.x - enemy.x)
634:   const dir = Math.sign(player.x - enemy.x) || 1
635: 
636:   // React to incoming projectiles.
637:   for (const p of fx.projectiles) {
638:     if (p.owner === player && !p.hit && Math.sign(enemy.x - p.group.position.x) === Math.sign(p.dir)) {
639:       const closing = Math.abs(enemy.x - p.group.position.x)
640:       if (closing < 4 && closing > .8) {
641:         if (Math.random() < .5) ai.blockTimer = .45
642:         else if (Math.random() < .35 && enemy.grounded) {
643:           doJump(enemy)
644:           ai.intent = dir
645:         }
646:         ai.think = .2
647:         return
648:       }
649:     }
650:   }
651: 
652:   // Don't be rude — the AI also has to breathe.
653:   if (ai.think > 0) {

## Objective
- Complete and verify a playable 3D street-fighting duel with three special moves.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them on completion.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks (viewport ≤1280px wide) and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Built “NEON FIST — Rooftop Reckoning,” a Three.js game with procedural 3D fighters, rooftop arena, synthesized audio, keyboard/touch controls, and three chi moves: Tempest Palm, Dragon Rush, and Heaven’s Wrath.
- Uses Vite; matches are best-of-three against AI.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented game, UI, arena, fighters, effects, and audio in `src/`.
- Installed dependencies; JavaScript syntax checks and `npm run build` passed.
- Started Vite on port 3002; confirmed HTTP 200.
- Opened the game in Playwright; menu and match-start flows work, and the browser reported zero errors.
- At a 1280×720 viewport, the match HUD displayed round timer, health/chi, specials, combo, guard, and pause controls.

### Active
- Exercise combat and special moves in-browser; check visuals and runtime behavior.
- Save and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot; fix any issues found and rerun build.

### Blocked
- JPEG screenshot attempt using `playwright-cli run-code "await page.screenshot(...)"` failed with `SyntaxError: Unexpected identifier 'page'`; use supported CLI screenshot options or correct the code quoting.

## Next Move
1. Continue browser testing at `http://localhost:3002`, including normal attacks, the three special moves, pause/resume, and match flow.
2. Save a JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest screenshot.
3. Address any issues found and rerun `npm run build`.
4. Summarize controls and assumptions on completion.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game entry document and UI structure.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and Three.js dependency.
- `src/main.js`: Game setup, controls, combat, AI, round flow, and rendering.
- `src/style.css`: Game presentation and responsive layout.
- `src/fighter.js`: Fighter models and animation.
- `src/arena.js`: Rooftop arena, lighting, and weather.
- `src/fx.js`: Combat effects and projectiles.
- `src/ui.js`: HUD, menu, pause, and result screens.
- `src/audio.js`: Procedural sound engine.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; no commit or push was made.
- Build previously warned that the minified JavaScript chunk is 661.85 kB.
- Playwright console reported zero errors; warnings included deprecated `THREE.Clock`, removed `PCFSoftShadowMap` fallback, and GPU `ReadPixels` stalls.
- Start control is `Enter`/`Space` or the “ENTER THE ARENA” button; movement A/D, jump W, guard S, strike J, kick K, specials Q/E/R, pause Escape/P.
